title: On two conjectures concerning Kemeny's constant of graphs
summary: Kemeny's constant for a connected graph $G$, denoted by $\mathcal{K}(G)$, is the expected time for a random walk to reach a randomly chosen vertex $u$, regardless of the choice of the initial vertex. Recently, Kim et al. (2026) proposed two conjectures on Kemeny's constant. The first conjecture asserts that if $G$ is a connected graph of order $n$ and diameter 2, then $\mathcal{K}(G) = O(n)$.
